svg.text: WEST RIDGE: chaparral + eucalyptus, 35 deg, to +180 m (backdrop)
SCRUB HILL beyond the rail cutting (backdrop)
marine fog pours over the ridge,
fills the pit -70 to -35 over the run
conveyor gallery, 75 m above the lake mid-span
RAIL in a cutting: stone trains W to E every ~3 min, 1.5 m/s on the grade
APRON: capped spoil, gold grass, fennel, pampas
to the loadout: the visible clock
invaders follow out of the gate
3 silos 30 m, red beacon, gantry: GOAL
top-down, 1 px = 1 m, north up, world coords (estate centre 0,0). Pit: 10 benches x 7 m (8 m treads), floor -70. Playable ~900 x 740 m.
HAUL ROAD ~2.1 km: fast, exposed, berms
THE CUT ~1.2 km: cover, close quarters
THE SPINE ~0.7 km: conveyor, one-way, loud
Contours every 7 m (one bench = one Grimble); bold rim line = z 0; rectilinear steps in the west lobe = sawn dimension-stone cut. Rifle lines from R and C reach 380 m.
Chokepoints: causeway, Spine mid-span (2 exit ladders, circled), drill stair, loadout gantry ladder.
